title: Checkpoint: Aligned Arena

tests.name: alignment skips padding
tests.hint: After a 3-byte slice the offset 3 aligns up to 8 — padding is consumed invisibly.

tests.name: used counts padding
tests.hint: used is the next free offset: 1 byte at offset 8 means 9 total.

tests.name: exhaustion respects align
tests.hint: A request larger than the whole buffer must fail even when the offset is aligned.

tests.name: reset rewinds
tests.hint: After reset the entire buffer serves one maximally aligned slice.
